critical_code_review_comments: routes/payroll.py _calc: when is_fixed=True and hours>0, rate_effective = fixed_amt/hours and advances_zl = adv_h * rate_effective. This means advance hours scale proportionally to the fixed salary distribution. Confirmed correct per spec but worth documenting in code comments to avoid future confusion.

PayrollRecord uses Pydantic without 'extra=forbid'. PUT with stale housing_zl from old clients silently passes (ignored). Acceptable for backward compatibility; alternative would be model_config = ConfigDict(extra='ignore') for explicit intent.
PUT /payroll loop coerces all non-is_fixed_salary fields via float(v or 0). If someone sends booleans for numeric fields they'd be converted (e.g. True->1.0) — minor robustness concern, low priority.
Frontend NumCell uses key={emp}-{field}-{initial} which re-mounts on each save; works for live recompute but loses focus mid-typing on slow saves. Current debounce-on-blur pattern mitigates this. OK.

PayrollAdmin.js stale comment at line 3-7 still mentions 'mieszkanie -' in the dosier; this is just a top-of-module docstring in payroll.py and was updated, but the module docstring should be revisited to fully reflect feature changes.
FRONTEND: rate read-only span uses text-[#94A3B8] (low contrast on #1E293B background). Consider #CBD5E1 for better readability — minor.
